tagline: Your WhatsApp, inside ChatGPT and Claude
brief: An open-source, self-hosted connector that brings a business owner's WhatsApp into ChatGPT and Claude. The mark must feel friendly and direct, never imitate WhatsApp or Meta, and work as a 16 px favicon.
criteria: Success: reads as W for Wavelink, owns a wave without a speech bubble or phone, holds at 16 px, works in one colour.

concepts.name: Wave-W
concepts.idea: One continuous wave that draws a W, with a dot as the message it carries.
rationale: The W and the wave are the same stroke: the name and the idea in one gesture
The dot is the link: a message leaving the wave for the AI on the other side
Built from 75° arms and two radii; a heavier small cut keeps it clear at 16 px
No speech bubble or phone, so it never reads as WhatsApp

recommendation: Wave-W in Wavelink Green, with the stacked lockup for square spaces and the small cut for favicons and app icons.
next_steps: Swap the website's header mark, favicon and social image for the new kit
Use the README banner and app icon in the GitHub repo
Run a trademark search before registering the mark
